import sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('w', W)
# also register the other namespaces declared on the root so output stays tidy
for pfx, uri in {
    've': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006',
    'o': 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'v': 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml',
    'wp': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing',
    'w10': 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word',
}.items():
    ET.register_namespace(pfx, uri)

path = 'unpacked_quarterly/word/document.xml'
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()

headline_paras, underlined_runs = 0, 0
for p in root.iter('{%s}p' % W):
    text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter('{%s}t' % W)).strip()
    # A headline = paragraph whose text is entirely upper-case and contains a letter
    if text and text == text.upper() and any(c.isalpha() for c in text):
        headline_paras += 1
        for r in p.iter('{%s}r' % W):
            rPr = r.find('{%s}rPr' % W)
            if rPr is None:
                rPr = ET.Element('{%s}rPr' % W)
                r.insert(0, rPr)
            # remove any existing underline, then add single underline in schema order (after sz/szCs)
            for u in rPr.findall('{%s}u' % W):
                rPr.remove(u)
            u = ET.Element('{%s}u' % W)
            u.set('{%s}val' % W, 'single')
            anchor = None
            for tag in ('{%s}szCs' % W, '{%s}sz' % W, '{%s}highlight' % W, '{%s}color' % W):
                el = rPr.find(tag)
                if el is not None:
                    anchor = el
            if anchor is not None:
                rPr.insert(list(rPr).index(anchor) + 1, u)
            else:
                rPr.append(u)
            underlined_runs += 1

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')
print('headline paragraphs underlined:', headline_paras)
print('runs underlined:', underlined_runs)
